mapper.select: SELECT work_unit_idx FROM tb_work_unit WHERE work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND del_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql:
SELECT t.wrk_todo_idx AS idx, t.wrk_todo_uuid AS uuid, t.ttl, t.dscr, t.sts, t.strt_dt, t.due_dt, t.cmpl_at, t.prgs_rt, t.sort_ord, t.created_at, t.updated_at, unit.work_unit_uuid, unit.ttl AS work_unit_ttl, unit.use_yn AS work_unit_use_yn, unit.sts AS work_unit_sts, parent.wrk_todo_uuid AS prnt_todo_uuid, parent.ttl AS prnt_todo_ttl, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_todo child WHERE child.prnt_wrk_todo_idx = t.wrk_todo_idx AND child.work_unit_idx = t.work_unit_idx AND child.mbr_acct_idx = #{req.mbrAcctIdx} AND child.del_at IS NULL ) AS leaf, CASE WHEN t.sts = 'DONE' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN t.due_dt < #{req.today} THEN 'OVERDUE' WHEN t.strt_dt > #{req.today} OR (t.strt_dt IS NULL AND t.due_dt > #{req.today}) THEN 'UPCOMING' WHEN t.strt_dt IS NULL AND t.due_dt IS NULL THEN 'UNSCHEDULED' ELSE 'TODAY' END AS todo_group FROM tb_wrk_todo t JOIN tb_work_unit unit ON unit.work_unit_idx = t.work_unit_idx AND unit.mbr_acct_idx = #{req.mbrAcctIdx} AND unit.del_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN tb_wrk_todo parent ON parent.wrk_todo_idx = t.prnt_wrk_todo_idx AND parent.work_unit_idx = t.work_unit_idx AND parent.mbr_acct_idx = #{req.mbrAcctIdx} AND parent.del_at IS NULL WHERE t.mbr_acct_idx = #{req.mbrAcctIdx} AND t.del_at IS NULL AND unit.use_yn = 'Y' AND unit.work_unit_uuid = CAST(#{req.workUnitUuid} AS UUID)
AND POSITION(LOWER(#{req.keyword}) IN LOWER(t.ttl || ' ' || COALESCE(t.dscr, ''))) > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaf_todos WHERE todo_group = #{req.group}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE todo_group = 'TODAY') AS today_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE todo_group = 'UPCOMING') AS upcoming_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE todo_group = 'OVERDUE') AS overdue_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE todo_group = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE todo_group = 'UNSCHEDULED') AS unscheduled_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE todo_group = 'COMPLETED' AND cmpl_at IS NULL) AS unknown_completion_count FROM leaf_todos
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_wrk_todo t SET cmpl_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN CASE WHEN sts = 'DONE' THEN cmpl_at ELSE now() END ELSE NULL END, sts = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'TODO' END, prgs_rt = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 100 ELSE 0 END, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE wrk_todo_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS UUID) AND work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND del_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_todo child WHERE child.prnt_wrk_todo_idx = t.wrk_todo_idx AND child.work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND child.mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND child.del_at IS NULL)
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM tb_wrk_todo WHERE work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND del_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(prnt_wrk_todo_idx, 0) ASC, sort_ord ASC, created_at ASC, wrk_todo_idx ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_wrk_todo ( work_unit_idx, mbr_acct_idx, prnt_wrk_todo_idx, ttl, dscr, sts, prgs_rt, strt_dt, due_dt, sort_ord, created_by ) VALUES ( #{workUnitIdx}, #{mbrAcctIdx}, #{prntWrkTodoIdx}, #{ttl}, #{dscr}, #{sts}, #{prgsRt}, #{strtDt}, #{dueDt}, #{sortOrd}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_wrk_todo SET prnt_wrk_todo_idx = #{prntWrkTodoIdx}, ttl = #{ttl}, dscr = #{dscr}, strt_dt = #{strtDt}, due_dt = #{dueDt}, sort_ord = #{sortOrd}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE wrk_todo_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS UUID) AND work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND del_at IS NULL
UPDATE tb_wrk_todo SET sts = #{sts}, prgs_rt = #{prgsRt}, cmpl_at = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE wrk_todo_idx = #{idx} AND del_at IS NULL
UPDATE tb_wrk_todo SET sort_ord = #{sortOrd}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE wrk_todo_idx = #{idx} AND del_at IS NULL

WITH RECURSIVE todo_subtree AS ( SELECT wrk_todo_idx FROM tb_wrk_todo WHERE wrk_todo_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS UUID) AND work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND del_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.wrk_todo_idx FROM tb_wrk_todo child INNER JOIN todo_subtree subtree ON child.prnt_wrk_todo_idx = subtree.wrk_todo_idx WHERE child.mbr_acct_idx = #{mbrAcctIdx} AND child.work_unit_idx = #{workUnitIdx} AND child.del_at IS NULL ) UPDATE tb_wrk_todo SET updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now(), del_at = now() WHERE wrk_todo_idx IN (SELECT wrk_todo_idx FROM todo_subtree) AND del_at IS NULL
